  const refreshToken = hashParams.get('refresh_token');\n\n    if (accessToken && refreshToken) {\n      await syncSessionFromTokens(accessToken, refreshToken, setSession);\n    } else {\n      await syncSessionFromCurrentAuth(setSession);\n    }\n\n    clearAuthHashFromUrl();\n  } catch (error) {\n    reportHomeAuthError(error);\n  }\n}\n\nfunction installStandaloneSessionRedirect(\n  navigate: (path: string) => void,\n): (() => void) | undefined {\n  if (!isStandaloneDisplayMode()) {\n    return undefined;\n  }\n\n  const delayedCheck = setTimeout(() => {\n    void supabase().auth.getSession().then(({ data }) => {\n      if (data.session) {\n        navigate(HOME_NAVIGATION.tools);\n      }\n    });\n  }, 500);\n\n  return () => clearTimeout(delayedCheck);\n}\n\ninterface HandleAuthEventInput {\n  event: string;\n  nextSession: Session | null;\n  pathname: string;\n  finalizeReferral: () => Promise<void>;\n  navigate: (path: string) => void;\n  setSession: (session: Session | null) => void;\n}\n\nasync function handleHomeAuthEvent({\n  event,\n  nextSession,\n  pathname,\n  finalizeReferral,\n  navigate,\n  setSession,\n}: HandleAuthEventInput): Promise<void> {\n  setSession(nextSession);\n\n  if ((event === 'SIGNED_IN' || event === 'INITIAL_SESSION') && nextSession && isStandaloneDisplayMode()) {\n    navigate(HOME_NAVIGATION.tools);\n    return;\n  }\n\n  if (event !== 'SIGNED_IN' || !nextSession) {\n    return;\n  }\n\n  const isHomePath = pathname === '/home' || pathname === '/';\n  const oauthInProgress = getStorageItem('oauthInProgress', 'useHomeAuth.readOAuthInProgress') === 'true';\n  if (oauthInProgress) {\n    await finalizeReferral();\n    removeStorageItem('oauthInProgress', 'useHomeAuth.clearOAuthInProgress');\n    navigate(HOME_NAVIGATION.tools);\n    return;\n  }\n\n  if (!isHomePath) {\n    navigate(HOME_NAVIGATION.tools);\n  }\n}\n\n// Full home page auth flow: iPad OAuth hash parsing, PWA redirect,\n// delayed session restoration, auth manager subscription + referral linking\nexport function useHomeAuth() {\n  const [session, setSession] = useState<Session | null>(null);\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const location = useLocation();\n  const finalizeReferral = useAuthReferralFinalize();\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    void restoreSessionFromHash(setSession);\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() => installStandaloneSessionRedirect(navigate), [navigate]);\n\n  const handleAuthEvent = useCallback(\n    (event: string, nextSession: Session | null) =>\n      handleHomeAuthEvent({\n        event,\n        nextSession,\n        pathname: location.pathname,\n        finalizeReferral,\n        navigate,\n        setSession,\n      }),\n    [finalizeReferral, location.pathname, navigate],\n  );\n\n  useAuthSessionLifecycle({\n    subscriberKey: 'HomePage',\n    onSessionEvent: handleAuthEvent,\n    errorContext: 'HomePage',\n  });\n\n  return { session };\n}\nEOF"
}
